purpose: Diagnostic cohort for the two tasks whose Codex install fails in snapshot im-01M376G3D7WYH73HT614RRXE5C: the installer clones nvm from /deps/git/github.com/nvm-sh/nvm.git, which is missing in these task images. Runs only after a snapshot or install fix that changes nothing but the install (same Codex/toolchain versions, model, prompts, oracle and egress policy as cybergym-e2e-paper-v1-r2). Results are reported pooled with cybergym-e2e-paper-v1-r2 as one 22-task cohort, with the different snapshot image disclosed and the 20-task single-batch rate given as a sensitivity check.
